data.narrative:
CreateMe operates in Robotics & Manufacturing, a sector populated by one public comparable (277810.KQ) and eight private peers including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. The company's stage, current valuation, and total capital raised remain undisclosed.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable to CreateMe. The analysis identified ten same-sector peers in Robotics & Manufacturing, but insufficient overlap exists when filtering by stage alignment, adjacent-stage positioning, or similar valuation tier. Application of an all-sector median would introduce material distortion given the heterogeneity of robotics company maturity, revenue profiles, and technology focus. A robust peer median requires a minimum of three comparable datapoints; none of the narrow filtering criteria yielded this threshold.

The narrow peer set—dominated by private companies with limited disclosure—prevents triangulation via traditional comparables methodology at this time. A defensible valuation range cannot be derived from the available data. Advancing the analysis would require either: disclosure of CreateMe's stage, revenue, or capital raised to enable tighter peer selection; access to recent financing rounds or secondary transaction data from the identified private peer set; or expansion of methodology to include venture capital cost-of-capital approaches, which fall outside the current dataset. Until these constraints are addressed, quantitative valuation synthesis is not supported.
